title: Identification and Validation of Diagnostic Model Based on Angiogenesis- and Epithelial Mesenchymal Transition-Related Genes in Myocardial Infarction.
authors: Li, Zhengmei; Wang, Shiai; Yin, Xunli; Tao, Dong; Wang, Xuebing; Zhang, Junli
one_liner_zh: 该文基于心肌梗死转录组数据构建诊断模型，虽含TF-基因调控网络和分子对接，但核心是疾病生物标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Myocardial infarction (MI) is a chronic cardiovascular disease. This study aims to discern potentially angiogenesis- and epithelial mesenchymal transition (EMT)-related genes as biomarkers for MI diagnosis through bioinformatics. METHODS: All datasets and angiogenesis- and EMT-related genes were collected from the public database. The differentially expressed genes (DEGs) of MI and MI-related genes were acquired. DEGs, MI-related genes, and angiogenesis- and EMT-related genes were intersected to obtain hub genes. Functional enrichment, immune microenvironment, and transcription factors (TFs)-hub genes regulatory network analysis were performed. The diagnostic markers and models were developed and validated. Drug prediction and molecular docking were performed. Finally, diagnostic markers expressions were validated using RT-qPCR. RESULTS: A total of 224 angiogenesis- and EMT-related genes, 2,897 DEGs, 1,217 MI-related genes, and 9 hub genes were acquired. The immune infiltration levels of plasma cells, T cells CD4 memory activated, monocytes, macrophages M0, mast cells resting, and neutrophils were higher in patients with MI. LRPAP1, COLGALT1, QSOX1, THBD, VCAN, PLOD1, and PLAUR as the diagnostic markers were identified and used to construct diagnostic models, which can distinguish MI from controls well. Then, 9 drugs were screened, and the binding energies ranged from -7.08 to -5.21 kcal/mol. RT-qPCR results showed that the expression of LRPAP1, PLAUR, and PLOD1 was significantly increased in the MI group. CONCLUSION: The 7 diagnostic markers may play potential roles in MI and could contribute to improved future diagnostics.
abstract_zh: 背景：心肌梗死（MI）是一种慢性心血管疾病。本研究旨在通过生物信息学方法，识别可能与血管生成和上皮间质转化（EMT）相关的基因，作为MI诊断的生物标志物。方法：从公共数据库中收集所有数据集及血管生成和EMT相关基因。获取MI的差异表达基因（DEGs）及MI相关基因。将DEGs、MI相关基因及血管生成和EMT相关基因取交集，获得核心基因。进行功能富集、免疫微环境及转录因子（TFs）-核心基因调控网络分析。开发并验证诊断标志物和模型。进行药物预测和分子对接。最后，使用RT-qPCR验证诊断标志物的表达。结果：共获得224个血管生成和EMT相关基因、2,897个DEGs、1,217个MI相关基因及9个核心基因。MI患者中浆细胞、CD4记忆激活T细胞、单核细胞、M0巨噬细胞、静息肥大细胞和中性粒细胞的免疫浸润水平较高。LRPAP1、COLGALT1、QSOX1、THBD、VCAN、PLOD1和PLAUR被确定为诊断标志物，并用于构建诊断模型，该模型能很好地区分MI与对照组。随后筛选出9种药物，结合能范围为-7.08至-5.21 kcal/mol。RT-qPCR结果显示，MI组中LRPAP1、PLAUR和PLOD1的表达显著增加。结论：这7个诊断标志物可能在MI中发挥潜在作用，并有助于改善未来的诊断。
